title: Core vocabulary
description: The ordered lists core defines for every family: validation phases, validation scopes with the phases each runs, result statuses, diagnostic severities, resolution stages and the reserved placeholder namespaces, as registry/vocabulary.json projects them from core's spec.md. spec.md is normative: the file is generated from it by task docs, and a file that disagrees with it fails task check:docs. Within a major version each list only grows, at its end.

major.description: The major version directory, such as v2.

phases.description: The validation phases, in the order an implementation applies them (core §6).

scopes.description: The validation scopes, from the narrowest to the widest, each with the phases it runs (core §6.1).

statuses.description: The statuses a validation result carries (core §6.1).

severities.description: The severities a diagnostic carries, the failing one first (core §7).

stages.description: The stages of the resolution phase, in the order they run (core §6.4).

namespaces.description: The reserved placeholder namespaces, a closed set, in the order core §5.2 lists them.

name.description: The scope, as a result's validationScope names it.

phases.description: The phases a result at this scope runs, in phase order.

name.description: The namespace, as a placeholder spells it.

assigned.description: Whether some family gives the namespace a meaning in this major version. An unassigned namespace may become assigned; an assigned one never becomes unassigned.
